themes_detail.label: Lead contamination spike
themes_detail.summary: Lead complaints in Sunset Park surged to 14 THIS WEEK, a 286% increase above the 8-week average of 3.6 per week (z-score: 6.01), raising urgent questions about water safety, paint hazards, or soil contamination in a neighborhood with significant pre-1978 housing stock.
evidence: 14 lead complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 3.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Sunset Park has substantial pre-1978 housing; lead paint and water infrastructure a known concern
reporting_angles: Interview HPD and NYC Health Department about source of complaints: Is this water-system related, paint abatement, or soil testing?
Investigate whether a school or daycare triggered cluster testing, or if residents responded to recent City outreach

themes_detail.label: Tree die-off emergency
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints hit 19 THIS WEEK, a 591% spike above the 8-week average of 2.8 per week (z-score: 6.28), suggesting possible disease outbreak, pest infestation, or environmental stress affecting street canopy across the district.
evidence: 19 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Community board has standing request for park/amenity expansion; tree loss worsens neighborhood green space
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Parks about any known disease or pest outbreak (emerald ash borer, oak wilt, etc.) in Sunset Park
Map complaint locations to see if die-off is concentrated in specific neighborhoods or wards

themes_detail.label: Commercial noise surge
themes_detail.summary: Commercial noise complaints jumped to 46 LAST WEEK, a 232% increase above the 8-week average of 13.9 per week (z-score: 5.33), potentially tied to new venue openings, construction, or changes in business licensing enforcement.
evidence: 46 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 13.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Sustained noise complaints remain top 311 issue (1,448 total across all categories in 90 days)
reporting_angles: Cross-reference with DOE permits: Are new restaurants, bars, or construction projects driving complaints?
Interview NYPD Precinct and 311 operators about enforcement response to spikes

themes_detail.label: Homeless encampment increase
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints rose to 19 LAST WEEK, a 217% spike above the 8-week average of 6.0 per week (z-score: 5.1), coinciding with community board's repeated annual budget request for expanded street outreach from NYC Department of Homeless Services.
evidence: 19 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 6.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Community board has filed street outreach funding request for multiple consecutive years (indicating persistent unmet need)
reporting_angles: Report on whether DHS street outreach has adequate capacity in Sunset Park; compare budget allocated vs. complaints filed
Identify geographic clusters of encampment complaints; interview service providers about bottlenecks

themes_detail.label: Mobile food vendor explosion
themes_detail.summary: Mobile food vendor complaints jumped to 5 LAST WEEK, a 1900% spike above the 8-week average of 0.2 per week (z-score: 10.97), suggesting either rapid proliferation of unlicensed carts or enforcement action concentrated in Sunset Park.
evidence: 5 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Unusual spike suggests either sudden influx of vendors or concentrated complaint campaign
reporting_angles: Contact DOHMH and DCA about licensing or enforcement sweeps in Sunset Park over past 2 weeks
Investigate whether complaints are clustered at specific locations (transit hubs, parks) or distributed
